title: Code Splitting
definition: Code splitting breaks a massive monolithic JavaScript bundle into smaller, logical chunks. These chunks are then loaded on demand (e.g., route-based splitting).
simpleExplanation: If a user visits the Homepage, do not force them to download the 5MB JavaScript code that runs the Admin Dashboard.

basic: How does Code Splitting fundamentally work?

advanced: How does Code Splitting scale in an enterprise architecture?
trick: Are there scenarios where Code Splitting is an anti-pattern?

answers.question: Define Code Splitting.
answers.answer: Code Splitting is essential for complex frontend applications.
